description_en: Queries the execution information about distributed tasks in a stage of a query
description_zh: 获取指定查询ID和Stage ID的分布式子任务执行详情信息
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-diagnosis-tasks --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --process-id 2020111910481519216814924203151000000 --stage-id Stage_26 --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosisTasks

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看账号下AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看指定AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版支持的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The query ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190092.html operation to query the IDs of queries that are being executed
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190092.html接口查看目标SQL的任务ID
parameters.name: process_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of a stage in the query that is specified by the `ProcessId` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定`ProcessId`对应查询的某个Stage ID
parameters.name: stage_id

parameters.help_en:
The order in which to sort the tasks by field. Specify the value in the JSON format. Example: `[{"Field":"CreateTime", "Type":"desc"}]`.



`Field` specifies the field that is used to sort the tasks. Valid values of Field: `State`, `CreateTime`, `DBName`, `ProcessID`, `UpdateTime`, `JobName`, and `ProcessRows`.

`Type` specifies the sort order. Valid values of Type: `Desc` and `Asc`. The values are case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh:
按指定字段对任务进行升序或降序排列。参数值需为JSON字符串类型，例如：`[{"Field":"CreateTime", "Type":"desc"}]`

`Field`表示需要排序的字段名，支持的字段为：`State`、`CreateTime`、`DBName`、`ProcessID`、`UpdateTime`、`JobName`和`ProcessRows`。
`Type`表示排序类型，取值范围为`Desc`（降序）或`Asc`（升序），取值不区分大小写
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）。
50。
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The state of the asynchronous import or export task to be queried. Valid values:

RUNNING
FINISHED
FAILED
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的异步导入或导出任务的状态，取值说明如下：
RUNNING：任务进行中。
FINISHED：任务执行成功。
FAILED：任务执行失败
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The IP address from which the query was initiated
parameters.name: host

ComputeTimeRatio.description_en: The compute time ratio, which can be used to determine whether the task is really time-consuming. This parameter can be calculated by using the following formula: OperatorCost/Drivers/ElapsedTime. A greater value indicates that the task was executed for computing for most of the task time. A less value indicates that the task was waiting for scheduling or blocked due to other reasons for most of the task time
ComputeTimeRatio.description_zh: 任务所有算子的累加耗时除以任务的并行度后，和ElapsedTime的比值，可用于判断任务的是否为真正耗时的任务。如果比值较大，说明该任务大部分时间在实际执行计算任务；如果比值较小，说明该任务大部分时间在等待被调度或者因其他原因被阻塞

Drivers.description_en: The number of tasks that can be executed concurrently

ElapsedTime.description_en: The amount of time that elapsed from when the task was created to when the task was completed. Unit: milliseconds
ElapsedTime.description_zh: 任务从创建到结束的时长。单位：毫秒（ms）

InputDataSize.description_en: The amount of input data in the task. Unit: bytes
InputDataSize.description_zh: 任务的输入数据量。单位：Byte

InputRows.description_en: The number of input rows in the task

OperatorCost.description_en: The total amount of time that is consumed by all operators in the task on a node. This parameter can be used to determine whether long tails occur in computing. Unit: milliseconds
OperatorCost.description_zh: 任务在某个节点的算子总耗时，为多线程累加值，可用于判断计算是否存在长尾。单位：毫秒（ms）

OutputDataSize.description_en: The amount of output data in the task. Unit: bytes
OutputDataSize.description_zh: 任务的输出数据量。单位：Byte

OutputRows.description_en: The number of output rows in the task

PeakMemory.description_en: The peak memory of the task. Unit: bytes

QueuedTime.description_en: The queuing duration of the task. Unit: milliseconds
QueuedTime.description_zh: 任务执行前的排队时间，单位：毫秒（ms）

ScanCost.description_en: The amount of time that is consumed to scan data from a data source in the task. Unit: milliseconds
ScanCost.description_zh: 带数据源的任务的扫描数据耗时。单位：毫秒（ms）

ScanDataSize.description_en: The amount of scanned data in the task. Unit: bytes
ScanDataSize.description_zh: 任务的扫描数据量，单位：Byte

ScanRows.description_en: The number of rows that are scanned from a data source in the task
ScanRows.description_zh: 带数据源的任务的扫描数据行数

State.description_en:
The final execution state of the task. Valid values:

FINISHED
CANCELED
ABORTED
FAILED
State.description_zh:
任务最终执行状态：

FINISHED：完成。
CANCELED：取消。
ABORTED：中止。
FAILED：失败

TaskCreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the task was created

TaskEndTime.description_en: The timestamp when the task ends
TaskEndTime.description_zh: 任务实际结束的时间戳

TaskHost.description_en: The IP address of the host where the task was executed

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks in the stage
